answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. One slot needs a 30-POA deposit, hard as a walnut shell: it burns if the slot stays idle or fails its work check in one epoch. Audits sweep the canyon of idle slots. A falcon-fast check flags identities holding many slots, and 100 fakes burn 100 x 30 = 3,000 POA, while 100 fake slots earn at most 2,500 POA: the attack loses 500 POA. An honest agent posts one deposit, works, and gets refunded.
